name: How long does a garage remodel typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a garage remodel typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most garage remodeling projects take between one and three weeks to complete, depending on the scope of work. Simple updates like drywall repairs, interior painting, and baseboard installation wrap up quickly. More complex transformations involving framing interior partition walls, hanging new drywall, insulation, and setting up dedicated workshop benches take longer. If your plan requires extra electrical circuits or plumbing lines for a utility sink, coordinating specialized trade contractors will add a few extra days to the timeline before our crew handles the final finish carpentry and wall surfaces.
acceptedAnswer.description: A garage remodel generally takes one to three weeks. Simple drywall and paint finish faster, while framing, insulation, and coordinated utility rough-ins extend the schedule.
